#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

class Main {
public:
    void execute() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        
        vector<int> basis(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x;
            cin >> x;
            basis[x] = 1;
        }

        vector<int> resultPoly = {1};
        int exp = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                resultPoly = multiplyPolynomials(resultPoly, basis, MOD);
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            if (exp == 0) break;
            basis = multiplyPolynomials(basis, basis, MOD);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int coef : resultPoly) {
            answer = (answer + (long long)coef * coef) % MOD;
        }
        cout << answer << endl;
    }

    vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int targetSize = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int size = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(targetSize - 1)));

        vector<double> ra(size, 0.0), ia(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            ra[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            ia[i] = x >> 15;
        }

        performFFT(ra, ia, false);

        vector<double> rb(size, 0.0), ib(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            rb[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            ib[i] = x >> 15;
        }

        performFFT(rb, ib, false);

        vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);

            double a1r = (ra[i] + ra[j]) * 0.5;
            double a1i = (ia[i] - ia[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2r = (ia[i] + ia[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2i = (ra[j] - ra[i]) * 0.5;

            double b1r = (rb[i] + rb[j]) * 0.5;
            double b1i = (ib[i] - ib[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2r = (ib[i] + ib[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2i = (rb[j] - rb[i]) * 0.5;

            resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        }

        performFFT(resR, resI, true);

        vector<int> result(targetSize);
        for (int i = 0; i < targetSize; i++) {
            long long valR = llround(resR[i]);
            long long valI = llround(resI[i]);
            long long val = (valR + ((valI % mod) << 15)) % mod;
            result[i] = (int)val;
        }
        return result;
    }

    void performFFT(vector<double>& real, vector<double>& imag, bool inverse) {
        int n = real.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int rev = __builtin_reversebits(i) >> shift;
            if (i < rev) {
                swap(real[i], real[rev]);
                swap(imag[i], imag[rev]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cosTable(half);
            vector<double> sinTable(half);
            double sign = inverse ? -1 : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * sign;
                cosTable[i] = cos(angle);
                sinTable[i] = sin(angle);
            }

            for (int start = 0; start < n; start += len) {
                for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                    double wr = cosTable[k];
                    double wi = sinTable[k];
                    double uR = real[start + k];
                    double uI = imag[start + k];
                    double vR = real[start + k + half] * wr - imag[start + k + half] * wi;
                    double vI = real[start + k + half] * wi + imag[start + k + half] * wr;

                    real[start + k] = uR + vR;
                    imag[start + k] = uI + vI;
                    real[start + k + half] = uR - vR;
                    imag[start + k + half] = uI - vI;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] /= n;
                imag[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.execute();
    return 0;
}
